audience: nonprofit fundraisers who report on campaigns, donations and recurring giving in Fundraise Up

useCases.title: Check which campaigns are live
useCases.text: List campaigns, filtered by parent, subaccount or designation. Open one campaign to read its status, designations and frequencies.

useCases.title: List recent donations by campaign
useCases.text: List donations, newest first, with amount, status, campaign and designation. Open one donation to read its fees and recurring-plan link.

useCases.title: Find cancelled recurring plans and reasons
useCases.text: List recurring plans with their status and cancellation details. Open one plan to read the cancellation reason.

useCases.title: Read a supporter record
useCases.text: Find a supporter and read the contact details and supporter-level fields. Open a donation to see the supporter it belongs to.

useCases.title: See what changed in the account
useCases.text: List the audit log of changes to donations, recurring plans and supporters, with the type and the affected object.
